description: This is a Perl script used in the OpenWrt project for downloading files from various sources and mirrors, handling checksum verification, and managing mirrors configurations.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from configuration files and environment variables.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Loads project-specific mirror URLs from JSON configuration.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a given program exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the hash command to use based on the provided checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a given tool (like curl or wget) is available and outputs its version.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Chooses the appropriate download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) based on availability and configuration.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Generates the command line for downloading files with the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the file download process from a mirror, verifying hash, and handling local files.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files related to downloads.
